Which nursing home deficiencies are cited most often?
SELECT deficiency_description, count(*) AS n FROM govblock_health.cc_nh_healthcitations WHERE deficiency_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many trademarks are sounds or scents, with no drawing at all?
SELECT count(*) AS marks FROM govblock_trademarks.tm_case_file WHERE mark_draw_cd LIKE '6%'
What kinds of schedule violations do water discharge permit holders commit most?
SELECT violation_desc, count(*) AS violations FROM govblock_environment.echo_npdes_ps_violations GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many SAM.gov registrants are based outside the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS entities FROM govblock_awards.sam_entities WHERE physical_address_country_code <> 'USA'
Which arXiv subjects saw the most papers revised four or more times?
SELECT primary_category, count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE try_cast(substr(latest_version, 2) AS integer) >= 4 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many federal defect investigations have involved Tesla vehicles?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS investigations FROM govblock_vehicles.nhtsa_investigations WHERE c2 = 'TESLA'
Which teaching hospitals received the most research money from drug and device makers?

SELECT teaching_hospital_name, sum(try_cast(total_amount_of_payment_usdollars AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_health.op_research WHERE teaching_hospital_name IS NOT NULL AND teaching_hospital_name <> '' AND teaching_hospital_name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
Did Maryland or Virginia get more federal contract dollars in fiscal year 2019?

SELECT primary_place_of_performance_state_code, sum(try_cast(federal_action_obligation AS double)) AS obligated FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_contracts WHERE primary_place_of_performance_state_code IN ('MD', 'VA') AND action_date_fiscal_year = '2019' GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which counties have the most facilities with significant violations?

SELECT concat(fac_county, ', ', fac_state) AS county, count(*) AS facilities FROM govblock_environment.echo_echo_exporter WHERE fac_compliance_status = 'Significant Violation' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many PubMed papers does PubChem link to aspirin?
SELECT count(DISTINCT c1) AS papers FROM govblock_chemistry.pubchem_compound_cid_pmid WHERE c0 = '2244'
Which federal district courts handled the most civil cases in the Federal Judicial Center's database?
SELECT c.full_name, count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_courts.fjc_integrated_database AS f JOIN govblock_courts.courts AS c ON c.id = f.district_id GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many Supreme Court decisions in the archive were decided 5 to 4?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_courts.opinion_clusters WHERE scdb_votes_majority = '5' AND scdb_votes_minority = '4'
What kinds of charter do active FDIC-insured institutions hold?

SELECT CASE bkclass WHEN 'N' THEN 'National bank' WHEN 'SM' THEN 'State member bank' WHEN 'NM' THEN 'State nonmember bank' WHEN 'SB' THEN 'Savings bank' WHEN 'SA' THEN 'Savings association' WHEN 'SL' THEN 'State savings institution' WHEN 'OI' THEN 'Insured branch of a foreign bank' ELSE bkclass END AS charter, count(*) AS institutions FROM govblock_finance.fdic_institutions WHERE active = '1' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many appendicitis cases did New York hospitals treat in 2016?
SELECT count(*) AS stays FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Appendicitis%'
Which kinds of Medicare Advantage plan enroll the most people?
Ma Enrollment By Contract Plan State County
SELECT plan_type, sum(try_cast(enrollment AS double)) AS enrollees FROM govblock_health.ma_enrollment_by_contract_plan_state_county WHERE plan_type IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the producer price index for all commodities moved year by year?
SELECT year, value FROM govblock_labor.bls_wp_data WHERE series_id = 'WPU00000000' AND period = 'M13' ORDER BY year DESC LIMIT 10
Which parent organisations received the most federal money in the last 12 months?
SELECT recipient_name, try_cast(last_12_months AS double) AS dollars FROM govblock_awards.usaspending_db_rpt_recipient_profile WHERE recipient_level = 'P' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many registrants offer engineering and technical support services (PSC R425)?
SELECT count(DISTINCT unique_entity_id) AS n FROM govblock_awards.sam_entity_psc WHERE psc_code = 'R425'
At which hours of the day does Texas solar output peak, on average?
Ercot Hourly Solar Report Cdr Pvgrhrlyavgactnp
SELECT hour_ending, round(avg(try_cast(system_wide_gen AS double))) AS avg_mw FROM govblock_solar.ercot_hourly_solar_report_cdr_pvgrhrlyavgactnp GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many active community water systems are there in the United States?
SELECT count(*) AS n FROM govblock_environment.echo_sdwa_pub_water_systems WHERE pws_activity_code = 'A' AND pws_type_code = 'CWS'
Which wind projects in Texas have the largest rated capacity?
SELECT p_name, max(try_cast(p_cap AS double)) AS project_mw FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE t_state = 'TX' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What share of air emission stack tests end in failure?

SELECT round(100.0 * avg(CASE WHEN air_stack_test_status_code = 'FAI' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 1) AS percent FROM govblock_environment.echo_icis_air_stack_tests WHERE air_stack_test_status_code IN ('PSS', 'FAI')
Which states have the largest households on average?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS avg_household_size FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b25010' AND a.variable = 'B25010_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many New York students qualify for free lunch compared with reduced-price lunch?

SELECT lunch_program, sum(try_cast(student_count AS double)) AS students FROM govblock_education.ccd_sch_033 WHERE school_year = '2024-2025' AND st = 'NY' AND data_group = 'Free and Reduced-price Lunch Table' AND (lunch_program LIKE 'Free lunch%' OR lunch_program LIKE 'Reduced-price%') GROUP BY 1 LIMIT 10
Which service occupations get the highest Service Contract Act wage rates?
SELECT occupation_title, round(avg(try_cast(rate AS double)), 2) AS avg_rate FROM govblock_awards.sam_wd_sca_rates GROUP BY 1 HAVING count(*) >= 50 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many quantum physics papers were first posted to arXiv in 2023?
SELECT count(*) AS papers FROM govblock_scholarly.arxiv_papers WHERE primary_category = 'quant-ph' AND substr(first_submitted, 13, 4) = '2023'
Which states have the most unequal incomes, by the Gini index?

SELECT g.name, try_cast(a.value AS double) AS gini_index FROM govblock_census.acs1_2024 a JOIN govblock_census.acs_2024_geos_1yr g ON g.geo_id = a.geo_id WHERE a.geo_id LIKE '0400000US%' AND a.table_id = 'b19083' AND a.variable = 'B19083_E001' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What is New York State's estimated population for 2025?
SELECT try_cast(popestimate2025 AS double) AS population FROM govblock_census.popest_co_est_alldata WHERE cast(sumlev AS varchar) = '40' AND stname = 'New York'
Which subsidized housing projects in California are the largest?
SELECT name, program_label, try_cast(total_units AS double) AS units FROM govblock_housing.hud_psh_project WHERE states = 'CA California' ORDER BY 3 DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
How many awards does a Grants.gov opportunity expect to make on average?
SELECT avg(try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double)) AS average FROM govblock_awards.grantsgov_opportunity_synopsis WHERE try_cast(expectednumberofawards AS double) > 0
Which counties produced the largest GDP in 2024?
SELECT geoname, try_cast(_2024 AS double) AS gdp_thousands FROM govblock_economy.bea_cagdp2 WHERE linecode = '1' AND geoname LIKE '%, %' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many published patent applications contributed reactions?
SELECT count(DISTINCT patentnumber) AS n FROM govblock_chemistry.uspto_reactions_applications
Which FCC licence files hold the most active licences?
SELECT uls_file, count(*) AS active_licences FROM govblock_consumer.fcc_uls_l_hd WHERE column05 = 'A' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
What were average hospital charges for a heart attack in New York in 2016?

SELECT round(avg(try_cast(total_charges AS double)), 0) AS avg_charges FROM govblock_health.ny_sparcs_inpatient_discharges WHERE discharge_year = '2016' AND ccs_diagnosis_description LIKE 'Acute myocardial infarction%'
Which NIH institutes are most often credited with funding published inventions?

SELECT level_three AS institute, count(DISTINCT pgpub_id) AS applications FROM govblock_patents.pv_pg_gov_interest_org WHERE level_two = 'National Institutes of Health' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How much have benefit plans reported paying insurance brokers in commissions?
SELECT sum(try_cast(ins_broker_comm_pd_amt AS double)) AS total FROM govblock_nonprofits.dol_f_sch_a_part1
Which power plants on the national map have the largest operating capacity?
SELECT name, try_cast(oper_cap AS double) AS capacity_mw FROM govblock_siting.hifld_power_plants WHERE status = 'OP' ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How has the number of NIH projects changed from 2015 to 2024?
SELECT fy, count(*) AS projects FROM govblock_grants.nih_projects WHERE try_cast(fy AS integer) BETWEEN 2015 AND 2024 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
Which countries were the biggest buyers of American soybeans in 2023?

SELECT c.cty_name, sum(try_cast(d.all_val_yr AS double)) AS dollars FROM govblock_trade.census_exp_detl AS d JOIN govblock_trade.census_exports_country AS c ON c.cty_code = d.cty_code WHERE d.commodity LIKE '1201%' AND d.year = '2023' AND d.month = '12' GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many patent cases were filed in the Eastern District of Texas in 2015?
SELECT count(*) AS cases FROM govblock_patents.litig_cases WHERE court_name = 'Eastern District of Texas' AND substr(cast(date_filed AS varchar), 1, 4) = '2015'
Which kinds of provider are most common among those enrolled in Medicare?
Medicare Fee For Service Public Provider Enrollment
SELECT provider_type_desc, count(*) AS providers FROM govblock_health.cms_medicare_fee_for_service_public_provider_enrollment GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
How many wind turbines reach higher than 150 meters at the blade tip?
SELECT count(*) AS turbines FROM govblock_energy.wind_uswtdb_uswtdb_v WHERE try_cast(t_ttlh AS double) > 150
What kinds of legal documents does the law collection hold most?
SELECT document_type, count(*) AS sections FROM govblock_law.law_combined GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 10
